_comment: Carry destination for R9-RC-Carry-Pins (#2075). Rounds 1-4 found four
ledger-subtree holes, all fixed on the branch and pinned by
tools/pr/app_approve.sh's own arms: a coarse whole-subtree exclusion that
hid a rewritten or deleted row (A2/A3), a glob-named added file that widened
one file's exclusion to the subtree (A9), a dead retired-path fallback, and a
delete-then-readd of the same reviewed path across two `ci: pin killed
mutants` commits (the `git cat-file -e "$v:$p"` guard). The one seam left
open is the BUDGET residual below; it is a carry because it is not a fix
this branch makes. The #2010 context-shift question earlier rounds carried
is now MOOT: #2010 merged (1b72ca19f), so its pair trivially carries and the
strict context-equal rule stays for a later round to re-measure with a fresh
instance, not to replay. The round-9 roster is not on main, so this file is
the in-tree destination, per the same shape as

carries.from: #2075 round 4, the BUDGET seam (recorded residual, not closed here)
carries.control: RESULT BUDGET, a bot-identity `ci: pin killed mutants` commit rewriting `tests/mutation_budgets.json` -- the single FILE entry `bot_paths` names -- carries at #2075's head, at origin/main, and under the round-4 reviewer's own `vbase` variant, because the file branch (`printf '%s\n' "$bt" | grep -qxF "$e"`) still excludes that exact file whole when the commit touched it. Measured by the round-4 reviewer's matrix (review-2075-r4 evidence/matrix.txt, the BUDGET row: CARRY at every copy) and unchanged by this diff. It is left open deliberately: it is main's existing behaviour, not one this branch introduces, and a hidden budget raise is re-graded at the pushed head by the required `budget-raise-gate` context, so a bot rewrite of the caps file cannot land a silent raise anyway.
carries.remeasure: At your merge base, plant a bot-identity `ci: pin killed mutants` commit that rewrites tests/mutation_budgets.json and run `bash tools/pr/app_approve.sh --carry <v> <h> origin/main`: it still answers CARRY. If the budget lane wants it to refuse, the file branch needs the same `$v`-existence narrowing the directory branch now has; until then, the residual stands and `budget-raise-gate` is its only backstop.
carries.brief: `carry`'s file branch excludes a `bot_paths` single-file entry whole whenever the commit touched that exact path, so a bot rewrite of `tests/mutation_budgets.json` (a reviewed budget file) is hidden from the branch's-own-diff comparison and the head carries. #2075 narrowed the DIRECTORY branch to additions not on `$v` but left the FILE branch as main had it; closing the file branch the same way is a separate change, and until it lands a hidden raise is caught only by `budget-raise-gate` re-running at the pushed head, never by the carry predicate.
